title: 阪神大賞典の後に・重なりゆく大波

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Observing her race today, I can tell that Tamamo Cross has gotten the hang of pacing herself during a long-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day, Oguri Cap wins a 2,000-meter graded race on turf. Her potential feels practically limitless at this point.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While caught up in the whirlwind of Oguri Cap's growing momentum, Tamamo Cross advances to the spring Tenno Sho.
